utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey — I’m sending it out now, and I really appreciate your help.

utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ve got the toolbox, screwdrivers, and hammer ready, and I’ll head over to Uli’s gate at 10.
